job.job_description:
Senior GenAI Engineer (Agentic AI Platforms)

Location

India (Hybrid/Remote)

Compensation

30-35 LPA (Flexible for exceptional candidates)

Experience

6-10 years

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced GenAI Engineer to build production-grade Agentic AI systems using the latest AI frameworks and cloud-native technologies. This role requires hands-on expertise in designing, developing, and deploying autonomous AI agents that solve complex business problems.

The ideal candidate has deep experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures, along with a strong product mindset and startup experience.

Key Responsibilities

Design and build Agentic AI applications using modern orchestration frameworks.
Develop multi-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and AI copilots.
Architect scalable GenAI platforms leveraging cloud-native infrastructure.
Integrate LLMs, RAG systems, tool calling, memory, planning, and reasoning capabilities.
Build robust backend services and APIs supporting AI applications.
Own the complete lifecycle from ideation, architecture, development, deployment, and production monitoring.
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
Evaluate and adopt emerging AI frameworks and technologies.

Required Skills

Agentic AI Frameworks

LangGraph
Claude Agents SDK
Nvidia NeMo / NeMo Agent frameworks
Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)

Programming & Architecture

Python
Microservices Architecture
REST APIs
Event-driven systems
Distributed systems

Cloud & Infrastructure

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Containerization (Docker)
Kubernetes
CI/CD pipelines
Observability and monitoring tools

AI/ML Expertise

Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
Multi-Agent Systems
Prompt Engineering
Agent Evaluation & Testing
AI Safety and Guardrails

Mandatory Qualifications

Bachelor's degree from a Tier-1 or top-ranked university (mandatory).
610 years of professional software engineering experience.
Minimum 34 years of experience working in startup environments.
Strong product development experience.
Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of complex products or platforms.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience delivering production-grade AI solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building enterprise-scale AI products.
Exposure to AI infrastructure optimization and model deployment.
Experience leading architecture decisions and mentoring engineers.
Contributions to open-source AI frameworks or developer communities.

What Success Looks Like

Building reliable and scalable agentic AI systems in production.
Driving AI innovation while maintaining engineering rigor.
Rapidly translating business requirements into deployable AI solutions.
Delivering measurable business impact through AI-driven automation.Role & responsibilities




Preferred candidate profile

Bachelors from Top universities ( don't consider people with Masters from top University but Bachelors is not from a good university)
At least 3-4 years experience in Startup
Good Communication
End to End ownership on the feature
Product development experience
At least 6-10 years experience
